Position Summary 		  Location: Phnom Penh (some travel outside PP)
Reporting to: Marketing Director
Probationary Period: 3 months
As Digital Marketing   and  Media Lead, you   will  lead Marie Stopes International Cambodia’s (MSIC) digital marketing work, ensuring MSIC   is  reaching   existing  and potential clients online   with  messaging   on  MSIC’s services,   with  the ultimate aim   to  drive client footfall   to  MSIC healthcare   service  delivery points. You   will  design   and  implement MSIC’s digital strategy   and  be   responsible  for creating content that can   be  used   on  a variety   of  digital platforms, including MSIC’s website,   and  social media channels.
Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Digital Marketing Strategy   Design  and Implementation
•  Review   the  MSIC marketing strategy   and  annual plan,   design  and implement   the  strategy/plan focused   on  digital marketing
•  Keep up-to-date   with  trends   in  population digital behaviour   and  new digital marketing approaches
•  Keep up-to-date   with  MSI’s global marketing guidelines   and  ensure MSIC   is  compliant where necessary
•  Propose   and  execute   new  ways   of  creating   and  distributing content that enables MSIC   to  reach   more  clients   with  information   and  sell   more  MSIC healthcare services
•  Implement   and  monitor MSIC digital campaigns by developing   and  uploading content   in  line   with  the digital marketing strategy
•  Support   the  MSIC   contact  centre staff   to  check MSIC social media profiles, including answering questions   and  inquiries   from  our clients when necessary
•  Design approaches   to  monitor   and  evaluate   the  effectiveness   of  MSIC’s digital marketing campaigns/content   and  take   on  board findings   to  design future approaches
•  Create monthly reports   on  MSIC’s digital marketing   activities  and results   and  present these   to  internal stakeholders when necessary
•  Ensure   any  donor deliverables   in  relation   to  digital marketing   are  delivered   on  time   and  on budget.
•  Creation   of  digital content   and  social media management
•  Create content   for  digital platforms   and  on occasions,   work  with creative/marketing/graphic   design  agencies
•  Develop content   and  keep   the  MSIC website up-to-date
•  Manage MSIC owned social media channels (Facebook, IG, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Business)   and  ensure audiences   are  engaged
•  Run results-driven paid and/or organic digital campaigns   on  Meta   and  TikTok
•  When necessary, take photos, film footage   and  carry out editing
•  Media Relations
•  Manage media relations, including relationships   with  journalists   and  influencers   for  review, stories, press releases,   and  interviews
•  Manage   all  media requests. Answer inquiries   from  the media   and  ensure that messages   are  in line   with  the MSIC brand   and  message
•  Actively connect   with  influential media outlets   and  journalists   to  place stories/ads about MSIC   and  relevant sexual   and  reproductive health news
•  If required, orient MSIC spokespeople   on  managing interviews   and  other media related-activities.
•  Case-study   development  and donor reporting
•  Respond   to  requests   in  developing case-studies   for  donor   projects  when necessary
•  Support donor reporting when required
•  Pro-Active MSIC Team Member
•  Work collaboratively   with  MSIC team members, seeking input into your work
•  Carry-out other duties delegated by   the  Marketing Director
Expected Profile of Candidates
Languages:
•   English  - Fluent
•   Khmer  - Fluent
Qualifications:
•  Bachelor's Degree   in  Communications, Marketing   or  relevant field   or  related experience.
Work History:
•  Work experience for  5  years  as a minimum
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
•  Experience   of  designing digital marketing strategies/campaigns/approaches   with  clear goals
•  Experience   in  producing   a  range   of  engaging content   for  a variety   of  online media
•  Experience   of  monitoring   and  evaluating   the  effectiveness   of  digital marketing approaches   and  using learning   to  influence future strategies
•  Experience   of  working   in  the health sector   is  desirable
•  Can develop innovative, engaging   and  creative content   for  specific target audience
•  Knows how   to  manage   and  monitor social media outlets like Facebook   and  YouTube
•  Displays in-depth knowledge   and  understanding   of  audience engagement strategies
•  Excellent written communication   skills  in Khmer   and  English
•  Has strong interpersonal & listening skills
•  Photography, filming   and  photo/film editing skills
Soft Skills
•  Strong supporter   of  sexual   and  reproductive health rights   for  all men/women, including abortion services
•  Results focused - goes above   and  beyond
•  Self-motivational/Self Starter
•  Team Player
•  Willing   to  provide capacity building   to  staff members   with  limited marketing knowledge
•  Must   be  committed   to  ensuring MSIC’s marketing approaches   are  inclusive   and  encourage marginalised groups   to  seek   and  access sexual   and  reproductive health services
